data.title: 雨夜木廊浴衣滑肩的梅酒余温
data.location: 细雨朦胧的温泉旅馆私密木廊
data.lighting: 室内纸灯暖光与廊外雨幕青灰微光

data.animaCaption: Leaning back on one palm along the rainy inn veranda with her loose navy yukata slipping off one bare shoulder and parting over her legs, she holds a tiny porcelain cup and looks over with a warm tipsy blush. Soft paper-lantern light gilds her shoulder against the misty blue autumn rain outside.
data.promptProse: Captured low along the warm wooden corridor of a quiet hot-spring inn while autumn rain falls softly outside the open railing, Shiki Natsume sits sideways leaning back on one hand in a loosely tied dark navy goldfish yukata. The wide kimono collar slides down to expose one bare shoulder and collarbone, and the lower folds part gently over her bare legs as she tilts a small ceramic cup of plum wine with a rosy flush and lingering amber eyes, split cleanly between golden shoji lantern light and the cool misty rain.
data.story: 檐外的秋雨把夜色洗得发凉，纸门透出的暖灯却把廊边照得发烫。微醺的夏目斜撑在木地板上，浴衣领口松松滑落一侧肩头，赤足悄悄碰了碰你的脚踝——「今晚的梅酒有点上头……别坐那么远，借我靠一下。」
